'''Jelven Donn''' was a [[Engineer/Legends|machinist]] in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While investigating ways to keep [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] profitable, Donn developed [[deep-miner]]s&mdash;powerful drilling devices that were capable of drilling down to previously unreachable depths and thus could reach resources that were thought to have been depleted.<ref name="TOR" />

However, Donn was unable to solve the issue of power consumption, burning out half a dozen deep-miners when their [[Battery/Legends|batteries]] overloaded. It was not until the Empire discovered the planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and its [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] during the Cold War that Donn managed to solve the problem&mdash;the amplifying properties of the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] allowed for the successful creation and deployment of deep-miners on Ilum, although the miners' deployment close to the planet's core was suspected of causing irregular seismic activity.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jelven Donn was mentioned in the Codex entry for deep-miners in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
